summary: You have been trapped in a scary house. Solve the puzzles to escape.
description:
The town of Hidden Town is scared. Very strange things are happening. Villagers claim to have seen the figure of a girl who looks out from the window of one of the houses. Which is very strange, because that house has been abandoned for 20 years.

The Girl in the Window is Dark Dome's first point and click game that would begin the series of a dark town called Hidden Town surrounded by ancient mysteries. In this escape the room suspense thriller game you play Dan, a curious guy who has entered an abandoned house and has been locked up. You will have to solve riddles and puzzles, open drawers and decipher codes, everything in your power to escape the room in this escape puzzle.
This is the introduction to two of our most beloved characters from the Hidden Town universe: Dan and Mia.

You can play the Dark Dome escape room games in any order, you will be able to see how the stories are connected in each chapter to reveal the mysteries of Hidden Town. This is our first episode and it has connections to our fourth escape puzzle game: The ghost Case.

- What you will find in this horror escape mystery game:
A room surrounded by puzzles, objects that move by themselves and characters that come to life. Observe the entire environment to be able to solve mystery case.
An interesting detective story with a lot of mystery and an unexpected plot twist. You won't believe the revealing ending.
A deep and dark art that will make you feel part of this horror mystery adventure from beginning to end.
A complete hint system that can guide you through this interactive detective story whenever you find yourself trapped.

- Premium version:
This escape the room game has a Premium Version with which you will access a secret scene in which you will play an additional Hidden Town story with extra riddles and puzzles. It will also remove all ads from the haunted house game, giving you access to all hints directly without seeing ads.

- How to play this suspense thriller game:
Interact with objects in the environment by touching them. Find hidden objects and inventory items in the game or combine them with each other to create a new item to help you continue the story.
Test your wits with these haunted house escape puzzle.
Unravel the Horror Mystery: Dare to Dive Deeper

Are you brave enough to unravel the secrets that lie hidden within the walls of the haunted house? With its gripping suspense thriller storyline and hair-raising atmosphere, this point and click escape puzzle promises an unforgettable gaming experience that will leave you breathless with anticipation.

“Immerse yourself in the enigmatic stories of the Dark Dome escape games and reveal all its secrets. There are still many mysteries to be unraveled in Hidden Town."
